detail.longDescription: On my Raspberry Pi 3b+ I couldn't make # NixOS boot from a USB SSD. I tried the vanilla aarch64 SD card, the nixos-raspberry pi installer, I tried building my own image based on my other Pi's config (4). The aarch64 # ArchLinux image booted for the first time... I guess I'll have to use Arch as well from now on... To be fair, I was getting fed up with the constant Raspberry Pi kernel rebuilds on NixOS, so maybe that's a good compromise. I am not sure how I am going to like the non declarative system management though, and I think this is going to be the make-or-break deciding factor. # SelfHosted # Linux
